ST MARGARET'S HOSPITAL NHS TRUST
Cardiology Ward 7B - DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Patient: Mr Derek HOLLOWAY    DOB: 14/03/1951    NHS No: 485 772 1093
Admitted: 02/10/2026    Discharged: 09/10/2026
Consultant: Dr A. Mensah (Cardiology)

Diagnosis: NSTEMI. Drug-eluting stent x1 to LAD (05/10/2026).
Also: new heart failure (EF 40%), fluid overload on admission - improved with IV diuretic.
Weight on discharge: 81.4 kg   BP 118/72   HR 64   Cr 98

MEDICATIONS ON DISCHARGE
- Aspirin 75 mg dispersible ONCE daily - lifelong
- Clopidogrel 75 mg ONCE daily - for 12 months from 05/10/2026 then STOP (aspirin continues)
- Atorvastatin 80 mg at NIGHT
- Bisoprolol 2.5 mg each morning (NEW)
- Ramipril 2.5 mg once daily (NEW) - uptitrate in community
- Furosemide 40 mg each MORNING (NEW)
- Lansoprazole 15 mg once daily while on clopidogrel (stomach protection)
- GTN spray 400 mcg: 1-2 puffs under the tongue for chest pain, may repeat after 5 min.

YOUR MEDICINE: ALENDRONIC ACID 70 mg tablet

Never take 2 tablets on the same day.

Stop and ring us if you get: heartburn, pain on swallowing, new thigh/groin pain, jaw pain.

documents.name: christmas_cake_recipe.txt
documents.text:
GRANNY MAY'S CHRISTMAS CAKE (1 x 20cm round tin)
Serves 16-20. Make 6-8 weeks before Christmas.

Ingredients
- 1 kg mixed dried fruit (sultanas, raisins, currants)
- 100 g glace cherries, halved
- 150 ml brandy, plus extra for feeding
- 250 g butter, softened
- 200 g dark muscovado sugar
- 4 large eggs
- 250 g plain flour
- 1 tsp mixed spice, 1/2 tsp cinnamon
- zest of 1 orange + 1 lemon
- 50 g ground almonds
- 2 tbsp black treacle

Method
1. Night before: soak the fruit in the 150 ml brandy, cover, leave overnight (or up to 3 days).
2. Heat oven to 140C / 120C fan / gas 1. Double line the tin with baking paper.
3. Cream butter + sugar, beat in eggs one at a time, fold in flour, spice and almonds.
4. Stir in soaked fruit, treacle and zest. Spoon into tin and level the top.
5. Bake 4 - 4 1/2 hrs. Take out when a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin.

Feeding plan
- Prick the top with a skewer and spoon over 2 tbsp (30 ml) brandy once a week.
- Feed weekly until 1 week before you ice it. Don't feed daily or it goes soggy.
- Wrap in baking paper then foil, keep in a tin. Keep seperate from strong smelling food.

Alcohol: about 0.6 units per slice if fed 6 times (more if you're heavy handed!)
Recommend: marzipan 1 week before Christmas, ice 2-3 days later.

documents.text:
8 WEEK STRENGTH PROGRAMME
Member: Dan Fowler    Coach: Kirsty    Start date: Mon 05 Oct 2026

Train 3 times a week (e.g. Mon / Wed / Fri), at least 1 rest day between sessions.
Warm up 10 min: bike + mobility. Cool down 5-10 min stretch.

SESSION A (Mon)
Back squat          4 x 6      start 60 kg, add 2.5 kg/wk
Bench press         4 x 6      start 50 kg
Bent over row       3 x 8      40 kg
Plank               3 x 45 sec

SESSION B (Wed)
Deadlift            3 x 5      start 80 kg, add 5 kg/wk
Overhead press      4 x 6      30 kg
Lat pulldown        3 x 10     45 kg
Walking lunges      3 x 12 each leg, 2 x 10 kg DBs

SESSION C (Fri)
Front squat         3 x 8      40 kg
Incline DB press    3 x 10     2 x 16 kg
Seated cable row    3 x 10     50 kg
Farmer's carry      4 x 30 m   2 x 24 kg

Rest 2-3 min between heavy sets, 60-90 sec on accessories.
Cardio: 20 min zone 2 (bike or incline walk) on 2 non-lifting days.
Nutrition: aim for ~140 g protein daily (1.6 g/kg at 87 kg).
Take a 25-30 g whey shake after training if you can't hit it from food.
Drink 2-3 L water a day. Sleep 7-9 hrs.
Deload week 5: same exercises, 2 sets each, ~70% of the weight.
Retest 1RM squat / bench / deadlift in week 8.

ALLOTMENT PLOT 17 - FEEDING SCHEDULE 2026
(Westfield Allotment Society, plot holder: Bev Morton)

General rule: little and often. Water first if the soil is dry, then feed.

GROWMORE (granular, 7-7-7)
- Beds before sowing/planting: rake in 70 g per square metre (about 2 handfuls)
- Top dressing in the growing season: apply 20 g per square metre weekly, Apr - Aug
- Dont let granules sit on leaves. Water in after.

TOMATO FEED (liquid, high potash)
Dose: 20 ml per 4.5 L watering can (1 gallon)
- Tomatoes, peppers, chillies: feed twice a week once the first truss has set
- Courgettes / squash: once a week from first flowers
- Stop feeding tomatoes end of Sept

SEAWEED TONIC
- 10 ml per 5 L, foliar spray every 2 weeks, morning or evening, not in full sun

FISH, BLOOD & BONE
- Fruit bushes + rhubarb: 100 g per sq m in March, again in June

LAWN (at home)
- Spring/summer lawn feed: 35 g/m2 every 6-8 weeks Apr-Sept. Do not double dose - it scorches.
- Autumn feed (low N): once in Sept/Oct untill the first frost

Day plan:
Mon - water greenhouse
Wed - tomato feed + check for blight
Sat - tomato feed, Growmore top dressing on beds, weed
Sun - seaweed spray (every other week)

Keep all feeds locked in the shed, away from kids and dogs. Wash hands after use.
